title: Kühlung Hills and Baltic Balcony
slogan: A 102 km loop out of Bad Doberan minster
story: The Rostock escape that actually feels like a ride. Out of Bad Doberan and back again: 102 km, roughly 1 h 46 in the saddle. It goes by way of Kühlungsborn sea road, Rerik coast view and Satow inland bends. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Baltic Coast Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 19 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

storyWas: The Rostock escape that actually feels like a ride.
